implementation: Original offline policy teaching model; no copied upstream code or schemas, no JWT verifier, no HTTP server, no external side effects.

sources.title: Model Context Protocol: Authorization tutorial
sources.author: Model Context Protocol contributors / Model Context Protocol, a Series of LF Projects, LLC
checked_facts: OAuth tutorial applies to HTTP transports; stdio uses environment or embedded-library credentials.
CIMD recommended for new implementations; DCR deprecated for compatibility.
Exact issuer, intended audience, lifetime and scopes must be validated.
expectedResource requires @modelcontextprotocol/express 2.0.2 and is ignored by earlier versions; it does not replace audience validation inside jwtVerify.
MCP 2026-07-28 has no sessions; session IDs must not establish identity for legacy clients either.
